description: THE AGM, BASED ON SUBSECTION 1 OF SECTION 3:223 OF ACT V OF 2013 ON THE CIVIL CODE, HEREBY AUTHORIZES THE BOD OF OTP BANK PLC. THE BOD IS AUTHORIZED TO ACQUIRE A MAXIMUM OF AS MANY ORDINARY SHARES ISSUED BY THE COMPANY WITH A NOMINAL VALUE OF HUF 100 THAT IS ONE HUNDRED FORINTS, AS ENSURES THAT THE PORTFOLIO OF OWN SHARES, IN RESPECT OF THE MEASURE STIPULATED IN THE RELEVANT PERMISSIONS OF THE MNB, DOES NOT EXCEED 70,000,000 SHARES AT ANY MOMENT IN TIME. THE BOD MAY EXERCISE ITS RIGHTS SET FORTH IN THIS MANDATE UNTIL 17 OCTOBER 2027. description: RESOLVE ON THE ALLOCATION OF NET INCOME, NI, FOR THE FISCAL YEAR ENDED DECEMBER 31, 2025. MANAGEMENT PROPOSES THAT THE NI FOR THE FISCAL YEAR ENDED DECEMBER 31, 2025, IN THE AMOUNT OF BRL 3,380,884,121.03, WHICH, AFTER THE REALIZATION OF THE REVALUATION RESERVE, RR, IN THE AMOUNT OF BRL 6,624,920.64, TOTALS BRL 3,387,509,041.67, BE ALLOCATED AS FOLLOWS, IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE PROPOSAL APPROVED BY THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS, BOD, AT ITS MEETING HELD ON FEBRUARY 4, 2026, I., ALLOCATION OF BRL 169,044,206.05 TO THE LEGAL RESERVE, 5 PERCENT OF THE FISCAL YEARS NI, BEFORE THE REALIZATION OF THE RR., II., DISTRIBUTION OF BRL 1,275,931,000.00 GROSS, EQUIVALENT TO THE NET AMOUNT OF BRL 1,123,051,939.64, AS INTEREST ON EQUITY, IOE, AS RESOLVED BY THE BOD AT THE MEETINGS HELD ON MARCH 25, 2025, JUNE 23, 2025, SEPTEMBER 22, 2025, AND DECEMBER 19, 2025, AD REFERENDUM OF THE GENERAL SHAREHOLDERS MEETING, AS RATIFIED BY THE MEETING, AND THE ALLOCATION OF BRL 804,616,208.90 OF THIS AMOUNT TO THE MANDATORY MINIMUM DIVIDEND FOR THE 2025 FISCAL YEAR, 25 PERCENT OF THE ADJUSTED NI FOR THE YEAR., III., DISTRIBUTION OF BRL 567,390,120.88 AS DIVIDENDS TO BE DECLARED BY THE SHAREHOLDERS MEETING, IN ADDITION TO THE IOE TO BE RATIFIED AS INDICATED ABOVE., AND IV., ALLOCATION OF BRL 1,375,143,714.74 TO THE RESERVE FOR MAINTENANCE OF EQUITY INTERESTS, PURSUANT TO ARTICLE 26, SOLE PARAGRAPH, OF THE COMPANYS BYLAWS. IF THE ABOVE MANAGEMENT PROPOSAL IS APPROVED, THE COMPANY WILL DISTRIBUTE TO SHAREHOLDERS 50 PERCENT OF THE 2025 NI, BEFORE THE REALIZATION OF THE RR, CORRESPONDING TO THE AMOUNT OF BRL 1,690,442,060.52, CONSIDERING THE SUM OF BRL 1,123,051,939.64, CORRESPONDING TO THE NET AMOUNT OF IOE TO BE RATIFIED BY THE MEETING, AND BRL 567,390,120.88, CORRESPONDING TO DIVIDENDS PROPOSED BY MANAGEMENT TO BE RESOLVED UPON BY THE MEETING. INFORMATION REGARDING THE COMPANYS PROPOSAL FOR THE ALLOCATION OF NI, PURSUANT TO ARTICLE 10, SOLE PARAGRAPH, ITEM II, AND ANNEX A OF CVM RESOLUTION 81, IS INCLUDED IN ANNEX II OF THE MANAGEMENT PROPOSAL
